SpaceX awarded additional NASA contract for ISS crew flights

NASA has awarded SpaceX an additional $946 million contract to conduct three more astronaut missions to the International Space Station (ISS). This extension will see SpaceX's crewed flights to the ISS continue through 2030. The new contract brings the total value of SpaceX's NASA astronaut flights to $5.92 billion. The agency has previously contracted SpaceX for crewed flights.
